notes.title: CAFE 0 ~The Drowned Mermaid~ Update and The Missing Persistent Save Data
notes.content:
CAFE 0 ~The Drowned Mermaid~ is now updated so that it will work with Mac OSx Catalina.

There is one problem though, the persistent save data which stores the information of the unlocked CGs, items and endings might be reset. This is also occurred in the Windows version.
The issue is happened because the previous version was made using Renpy 6.99.6 and to work with Catalina, I need to update the Renpy version to 7.3.5. 
To make the save data work with the newest version, you need to open the save data step-by-step from Renpy 6.99.6, 6.99.7 to 6.99.8 (or 6.99.9) before opening it with this version. I'm very sorry but I'm clueless myself about what might cause this issue.

The solution I can offer are:
1. Send me your persistent save data inside game/saves/ folder and I will fix that and send it back to you.
2. I can send you the persistent save data with a cleared game data to unlock all the CGs and others, but please don't use this if you haven't fully cleared the game as it might mess up with your achievements.

This issue doesn't happen with the French version though as it's made using Renpy 7.2.2.

The regular save data which saves your gaming progress will not be affected and won't be reset. This issue is only related with the persistent data.

The game update is at late October 18, 2019, so people who played after the update will not be affected.


I'm very sorry for the inconvenience.

Regards,
Roseverte

notes.title: CAFE 0 The Drowned Mermaid 1.4.1 Update
notes.content:
I was thinking to notarize this game to make it work with Mac Catalina, but then I noticed the current version doesn't work well even in my High Sierra (Windows one is okay). The major problem are "achievements are not triggered", and "depends on the language the game might not be able to launch on Mac." These are fixed now.

I'm very sorry that I'm very late to notice it. The notarization might take a while as there are too many build to update at my side. At the mean while, I updated the current game with renpy 7.3.5, so it will work fine with all Mac including Catalina.
Still, it needs to be notarized or it will stop working at 2020.

This game though, is not my prioritize yet, and therefore I will notarize it later after I've done with my others game.

If you got any issue in playing, you can contact me at anytime at support@roseverte.net

Thank you very much for the attention.

notes.title: Crash and virus problem
notes.content:
Lately I got so many reports about the game is getting detected as virus.
This game is not a virus, and the detection is a false positive.
Yet, even if I reported that to the anti virus company, only small of them will really pay attention and reply to me.

I found a way to make an exe which is less detected as virus, yet still some antivirus might ask you to block or allow the exe. Please choose allow and add it at exception (for AVG etc). That's the most effective and fast way rather than waiting for the anti virus answer.

ABOUT THE CRASH
Some of you might get the Steam Client crash when you try to play the new version of the game. If you're using avast, it is what caused the issue.
I tested my games on avast 10.1 and all renpy games (cafe 0 and duplicity) doesn't work, except those version which I already submitted to avast to whitelist (yet AVG still detected this version highly as virus and automatically send it to virus vault without giving options to put it as exception)

How to fix: update to avast 11.1
I tried this and it works on my pc. Idk why renpy games stuck with ver 10.1 but this solve the issue.
Remember to update the program, not the virus definition (you can update both, but the program is the important one)

Thank you.

notes.content:
I just added a new update to fix the missing executable/ missing file/ not launch and other issue which is occurred within the newest version of Cafe 0 in some PCs. The only things different is only the exe file.
I already scan the exe with avast before uploading this time and it says the file is not a threat. Hope this fix.

notes.title: How to redeem Steam Keys if you have purchased the game before.
notes.content:
You can redeem the Steam Keys if you have bought the game before. 
*This only applied for people who bought the Win/Mac/Linux version, not the mobile ones. 

For Bundles' Purchasers
Please contact Indie Royale/Indie Gala or Groupees since I've sent the keys to all parties. 

For People Who Bought The Hardcopies or Bought Through BMT Micro/Official Site
Please fill in the form on the link below and I'll send you the keys later. 
CLICK HERE

For People Who Bought Through Desura
First, please make sure that you didn't buy through bundle.
Check the key's category, and if it says Indie Gala or Groupees it means you need to contact them to get the keys.
Other than that, please PM me through Desura and give me the details (keys etc) if available.
